newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basic to acquire stake in British firm.
newsitem.headline: Basic to acquire stake in British firm.

text.p: Basic Petroleum & Minerals Inc said on Thursday it will acquire a 30 percent stake in leisure firm Olympic Gold Plc of United Kingdom.
Basic president Oscar de Venecia said Basic will invest up to 220 million pesos in the venture.

De Venecia said Olympic Gold has the exclusive right to operate an on-line lottery in Crimea and Ukraine. The firm also operates a casino, hotel, entertainment and shopping complex in Baku City, Azerbaijan.

De Venecia said the company will be renamed Basic Consolidated Inc since other than oil exploration, the firm is involved in petrochemicals, industrial gases, crystal manufacturing and property development.
